descripcion: Bancada checks laptops and desktops part by part on Windows and Linux: keyboard, display, battery, drives, memory, CPU, GPU and more. Native, free and open source.
hero_etiqueta: Hardware diagnostics · free and open source
hero_titulo: The test bench for every machine that crosses your workbench.
hero_texto: Run Bancada on the laptop or desktop you are checking, see what is inside and test every part, from the keyboard to the GPU. At the end, a PDF report ready for the customer.
hero_nota: A single file of about 60 MB · no install · Windows 10/11 and Linux x64
pruebas_texto: Every test ends with a verdict: works fine, has issues or doesn't work. Automatic tests suggest one and you decide.
p_inicio_d: Make, model and serial, CPU, RAM per slot, GPUs, drives, battery, motherboard and BIOS.
p_revision_d: Walks you through the hands-on tests while it runs the automatic ones by itself. About 20 minutes.
p_teclado_d: Keyboard drawn with its real shape (ISO, ANSI, ABNT2). Every key that arrives lights up.
p_puntero_d: An area that fills in as you move, buttons, gestures, wheel, touchscreen and pen.
p_pantalla_d: Full-screen colours, gradients and grid to spot dead pixels and backlight bleed.
p_audio_d: Left and right speaker, a low-to-high sweep and the microphone with record and play back.
p_camara_d: Live picture from every camera. Warns if it is black. Nothing is saved.
p_red_d: Adapters, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, step-by-step connection check and Internet speed.
p_usb_d: Marks every port that responds with its real speed. Spots USB 3 running as USB 2.
p_bateria_d: Health and cycles, live power draw, real runtime per type of use and a charger test.
p_discos_d: SMART health, errors logged by the system and real read and write speed.
p_memoria_d: 8 patterns over all free memory, bit by bit.
p_procesador_d: Stress test that detects overheating, thermal throttling and calculation errors.
p_grafica_d: Stress any GPU with verified calculations, plus a video memory test.
p_suspension_d: Sleeps, wakes up and checks that the network and devices come back.
p_placa_d: Firmware, TPM, failing devices, PCIe links, hardware errors and CMOS battery.
p_informe_d: Every test with measurements, notes and verdicts, on an A4 page ready to hand over.
capturas_texto: A native interface with the look of a circuit board: green solder mask, copper traces and silkscreen.
ficha_texto: Made by technicians, for technicians. One file, nothing to install.
f_formato_v: One self-contained executable of about 60 MB
f_interfaz_v: Native, with each system's look and feel (Avalonia 12 on .NET 10)
f_permisos_v: Regular user; as administrator or with sudo, also RAM modules, serial and SATA SMART
f_idiomas_v: Español, English, Português, Français, Deutsch, Italiano
f_informe_v: A4 PDF in the chosen language
privacidad_titulo: Your machines and your customers' stay on the bench
privacidad_texto: Bancada collects and sends no data. Camera and microphone are never recorded, and the report stays in your Documents folder. It only goes online to:
priv1: Check the connection (router, DNS and a secure website).
priv2: Measure speed, only when you press the button (Cloudflare).
priv3: Compare the motherboard clock with Internet time.
priv4: Open web pages in the browsing mode of the battery test.
apoyar_texto: Bancada has no paid edition. If it saves you time at the workbench, you can help it keep growing.
pie_texto: Free and open source hardware diagnostics.
pie_cookies: This site uses no cookies or trackers.
hero_guia: First time? See how it works
como_texto: Check the whole machine with the step-by-step guide, or go straight to the part you care about. You can mix both: whatever you test on your own also goes into the report.
modo1_d: To check a machine from top to bottom before selling, returning or buying it.
modo1_p1: In the sidebar, open Full check-up and press Start the check-up.
modo1_p2: Do what each step asks: press keys, look at the screen, listen, plug in a USB device… Meanwhile, drives, network, memory, CPU and GPU are tested on their own.
modo1_p3: Skip any step you don't need. When you are done, press Finish and view the report.
modo2_d: To check something specific: a faulty keyboard, a suspicious battery, a noisy drive.
modo2_p1: Pick the test in the sidebar, for example Keyboard or Battery.
modo2_p2: Follow the on-screen instructions. Automatic tests suggest a verdict.
modo2_p3: At the bottom, mark Works fine, Has issues or Doesn't work. The dot in the sidebar changes colour.
como_informe: Either way, the report gathers everything you tested: add your notes and press Save report as PDF.
